description: The full text of one atlas record by the id that search returned ("compound:cbd", "target:CB1", "condition:epilepsy", "trial:NCT03883360", "cultivar:STRAIN0001"): what it is, the targets and effects with evidence grades, measured binding values, cautions, every source (PubMed ids with links) and the citation line, with the atlas url. Educational reference, not medical advice. No doses.
